subject: Operations
title: Geopolitical Risk
description: A micro-lesson that makes Geopolitical Risk usable.

hook.text: Overnight, tariffs on Chinese goods jumped 25%. Companies that sourced 100% from China scrambled to find alternatives.

buildup.text: Geopolitical risk includes trade wars, sanctions, political instability, and regulatory shifts that disrupt supply.

discovery.text: Diversifying sourcing across countries and regions reduces exposure to any single government's decisions.

twist.text: Reshoring avoids geopolitical risk but raises labor costs. There's no risk-free option—only tradeoffs.

climax.text: Companies now use geopolitical risk scores to evaluate sourcing decisions alongside cost and quality metrics.

punchline.text: Politics shape supply chains as much as economics do.

quiz.question: How can companies reduce geopolitical supply chain risk?
